## Important Scientific Integrity Rule

No file in this folder may be used in any research paper claim until:

1. The input raw data files are confirmed to exist in folders 01 through 07.
2. The processing script has been run without errors.
3. The output raster or CSV has been visually verified against known geography (Rajendra Nagar, Kankarbagh visible in flood map).
4. Results are documented with the exact script name, input file names, and date of execution.

This folder is the ONLY source of real research results. The old `patna_multihazard_pipeline.py` simulation outputs are NOT to be used as research evidence.
